policy: Each article's evidence reference is an exact test title (or the Article 1 audit-table anchor), not merely a file path. CI verifies the file exists, the referenced test title exists verbatim, and the title explicitly names the article or a containing article range. This is an evidence-index integrity check, not a proof that a finite test exhausts every subparagraph, lexical item, or productive morphological pattern. 'verified' is limited to the official standard's enumerated examples and the explicitly referenced contrasts/interactions. The engine must fail on incorrect expected surface forms, unresolved placeholders in cases claimed resolved, duplicate/missing evidence, or contradictions between lexical and rule output. Ukrainian targets are project-level approximations, never official NIKL prescriptions. Article 1 is a governing principle rather than a standalone phonological rewrite.
